text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our fourth concert comes to an end in
the blink
of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming to see us today,
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
No, thank YOU! You were great!
Good
luck with the Grand Concert!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka pauses on stage for a
moment,
listening to the fans.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, this seems like a good time for me
to slip
out. Be sure to take everyone's

pulse—immediately, please.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It's the small steps we take every day
that will
help prove my hypothesis in the
end.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What indeed.
choice_data_list: What is it you want to prove?
What is it you're trying to prove?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you must know, then I might say... a
"wish."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I hope hearing her fans' voices during
the
concert has encouraged
<chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I hope she's been able to fulfill
whatever
ambitions drew her to the
Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that would be my wish, as a
trainer who
can only cheer her on from
off stage.
...ner? Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hello? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to bother while you're
preoccupied. There's
something I really
wanted to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to ask the academy to hold
an
information session on the Grand
Concert.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Our concerts have gotten us more
supporters
among the students, and
consequently, many fans
as well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Which is why it's time to face our
remaining
problems head-on.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There are still people to whom I must
give a
proper explanation for the Grand
Concert.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the students of the academy and
the URA
director's board.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'll continue to negotiate with the board,
but in
the meantime, I'd like to speak to
the academy
students in my own words.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
My words as someone who wants to see
a concert
for both Umamusume and
fans... and as a fan
myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You really don't have to. You've helped
me more
than enough already, and I
wouldn't want to
burden you further.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list: I'm a fan too, so I want to help out.
I'm a fan too, so I want to help.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Well, that would be very much
appreciated. I
guess we're in this
together until the end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Light Hello and I get
Director
Akikawa's permission to hold an
info session for
the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All of our hard work will be worth it in
the end.
We have to do everything we
can to support the
girls!
